collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A friend confides a planned surprise gift for their partner, and curious villagers try to get the secret out.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A friend confides that they are planning a surprise gift for their partner, and several curious villagers try to get the secret out of (name1), the listener.

choices.label: Warn the Friend That People Are Curious.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The curious villagers give up, and the surprise works perfectly.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One villager guesses anyway, but the listener confirms nothing.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The talk turns to fishing, and the secret is safe.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The change is so obvious that everyone knows something is going on.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Everyone respects that, and the matter is dropped.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The curiosity grows, but the friend's surprise still succeeds.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The friend moves the gift to a better hiding place.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The friend decides to give the gift early before anyone guesses.
